Car loan interest deduction

If you or your spouse paid car loan interest in , you may be able to deduct up to of the interest you paid.

To qualify for the deduction, the interest must be paid on a loan that:

  • Originated in 2025 or later
  • Is backed by a lien on the vehicle (a legal claim placed on the vehicle by the creditor to ensure payment)
  • Is used to purchase a qualifying vehicle for personal use

A qualifying vehicle is a car, minivan, van, sport utility vehicle, pickup truck, or motorcycle that:

  • Is new (not used)
  • Went through final assembly in the U.S.
  • Has a gross vehicle weight of less than 14,000 lbs.
  • Is manufactured primarily for use on public streets, roads, and highways

facts.description: Form 8959 Part I Line 5 and II Line 9
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/additionalMedicareTaxThreshold">
  <Description>Form 8959 Part I Line 5 and II Line 9</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/additionalMedicareTaxThresholdForMFJ"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFS"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/additionalMedicareTaxThresholdForMFS"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/additionalMedicareTaxThresholdForAllOtherTPs"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Form 8959 Part I Line 8. Per the Form instructions, this should include the total Medicare wages and tips plus your self-employment income, if any (including the Medicare wages and tips and self-employment income of your spouse, if married filing jointly), are greater than the threshold amount for your filing status The following simplifying assumption was made for user convenience: we derive Form 8959 Line 8 from /netSelfEmploymentIncomeSelf and/or Spouse instead of /scheduleSELine6Self and/or Spouse
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/selfEmploymentIncomeForm8959Line8">
  <Description>Form 8959 Part I Line 8. Per the Form instructions, this should include the total Medicare wages and tips plus your self-employment income, if any (including the Medicare wages and tips and self-employment income of your spouse, if married filing jointly), are greater than the threshold amount for your filing status
        The following simplifying assumption was made for user convenience: we derive Form 8959 Line 8 from /netSelfEmploymentIncomeSelf and/or Spouse instead of /scheduleSELine6Self and/or Spouse</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/scheduleSELine6Self"/>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dependency path="/scheduleSELine6Spouse"/>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/excessMedicareTaxForm5969Line11">
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency path="/additionalMedicareTaxThreshold"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency path="/totalMedicareWagesForm8959Line4"/>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/excessSelfEmploymentIncomeOfExcessMedicareTaxForm5969Line12">
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency path="/selfEmploymentIncomeForm8959Line8"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency path="/excessMedicareTaxForm5969Line11"/>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/additionalMedicareTaxOnSelfEmploymentIncomeForm8959Line13">
  <Derived>
    <Multiply>
      <Dependency path="/excessSelfEmploymentIncomeOfExcessMedicareTaxForm5969Line12"/>
      <Dependency path="/additionalMedicareTaxMultiplier"/>
    </Multiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/additionalMedicareTaxOnRRTAForm8959Line17">

    <Dollar>0</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: https://www.irs.gov/credits-deductions/individuals/adoption-credit#qualifiedexpenses Qualified adoption expenses for the credit and exclusion are reasonable and necessary expenses you paid to adopt include: - Adoption fees - Attorney fees - Court costs - Travel expenses including meals and lodging - Other expenses directly for the legal adoption - Expenses you paid before an eligible child has been identified, such as home study fees Expenses aren’t eligible if they are: - To adopt your spouse’s child - For a surrogate parent arrangement - Allowed for another federal tax credit or deduction - Paid by a federal, state or local program - Reimbursed by your employer
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/estimatedTotalQualifiedAdoptionExpenses">
  <Description>https://www.irs.gov/credits-deductions/individuals/adoption-credit#qualifiedexpenses
        Qualified adoption expenses for the credit and exclusion are reasonable and necessary expenses you paid to adopt include:
        - Adoption fees
        - Attorney fees
        - Court costs
        - Travel expenses including meals and lodging
        - Other expenses directly for the legal adoption
        - Expenses you paid before an eligible child has been identified, such as home study fees

        Expenses aren&#x2019;t eligible if they are:
        - To adopt your spouse&#x2019;s child
        - For a surrogate parent arrangement
        - Allowed for another federal tax credit or deduction
        - Paid by a federal, state or local program
        - Reimbursed by your employer</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Dollar/>
  </Writable>
  <Placeholder>
    <Dollar>0</Dollar>
  </Placeholder>
</Fact>

facts.name: Care Expenses Decimal Amount
facts.description: Care Expenses Decimal Amount. Form 2441, Line 8. Line 7 is AGI.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/cdccCareExpensesDecimalAmount">
  <Name>Care Expenses Decimal Amount</Name>
  <Description>Care Expenses Decimal Amount. Form 2441, Line 8. Line 7 is AGI.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2026</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThanOrEqual>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/agi"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </LessThanOrEqual>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThanOrEqual>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/agi"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesInitialPhaseInStart"/>
            </Right>
          </LessThanOrEqual>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0.5</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <GreaterThan>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/agi"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesInitialPhaseInStart"/>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThan>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/agi"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesInitialPhaseOutThreshold"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Subtract>
            <Minuend>
              <Dollar>0.49</Dollar>
            </Minuend>
            <Subtrahends>
              <Divide>
                <Dividend>
                  <StepwiseMultiply>
                    <Multiplicand>
                      <Subtract>
                        <Minuend>
                          <Dependency path="/agi"/>
                        </Minuend>
                        <Subtrahends>
                          <Add>
                            <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesInitialPhaseInStart"/>
                            <Dollar>0.01</Dollar>
                          </Add>
                        </Subtrahends>
                      </Subtract>
                    </Multiplicand>
                    <Rate>
                      <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesInitialPhaseOutRate"/>
                    </Rate>
                  </StepwiseMultiply>
                </Dividend>
                <Divisors>
                  <Int>100</Int>
                </Divisors>
              </Divide>
            </Subtrahends>
          </Subtract>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <GreaterThan>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/agi"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesInitialPhaseOutThreshold"/>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThan>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/agi"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesAdditionalPhaseInStart"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0.35</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <GreaterThan>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/agi"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesAdditionalPhaseInStart"/>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThan>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/agi"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesAdditionalPhaseOutThreshold"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Subtract>
            <Minuend>
              <Dollar>0.34</Dollar>
            </Minuend>
            <Subtrahends>
              <Divide>
                <Dividend>
                  <StepwiseMultiply>
                    <Multiplicand>
                      <Subtract>
                        <Minuend>
                          <Dependency path="/agi"/>
                        </Minuend>
                        <Subtrahends>
                          <Add>
                            <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesAdditionalPhaseInStart"/>
                            <Dollar>0.01</Dollar>
                          </Add>
                        </Subtrahends>
                      </Subtract>
                    </Multiplicand>
                    <Rate>
                      <Dependency path="/cdccCareExpensesAdditionalPhaseOutRate"/>
                    </Rate>
                  </StepwiseMultiply>
                </Dividend>
                <Divisors>
                  <Int>100</Int>
                </Divisors>
              </Divide>
            </Subtrahends>
          </Subtract>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0.2</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Rounded dependent credit MAGI above threshold
facts.description: In whole $1,000s, the amount of excess income above the threshold. Per §24(b)(2), any fraction of $1,000 is rounded to $1,000. Reported on line 10 of Form 8812.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/roundedDependentCreditMagiAboveThreshold">
  <Name>Rounded dependent credit MAGI above threshold</Name>
  <Description>In whole $1,000s, the amount of excess income above the threshold. Per
        &#xA7;24(b)(2), any fraction of $1,000 is rounded to $1,000. Reported on line 10 of
        Form 8812.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>

        <Multiplicand>

            <Dependency path="/dependentCreditMagiAboveThreshold"/>

facts.name: Total CTC from the CTC/ODC
facts.description: Total amount of CTC the TP will receive after the phaseout. It is derived and used for us to help the taxpayer make sense of how much of their credit comes from ctc, but it does not exist directly on schedule 8812. CTC credits are applied after ODC credits as per the IRM and when there is a phase out are reduced after ODC credits.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/totalCtc">
  <Name>Total CTC from the CTC/ODC</Name>
  <Description>Total amount of CTC the TP will receive after the phaseout. It is derived and used for us to help the taxpayer make sense of how much of their credit comes from ctc, but it does not exist directly on schedule 8812. CTC credits are applied after ODC credits as per the IRM and when there is a phase out are reduced after ODC credits.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Equal>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/totalCtcAndOdc"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </Equal>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Subtract>
            <Minuend>
              <Dependency path="/totalCtcAndOdc"/>
            </Minuend>
            <Subtrahends>
              <Dependency path="/totalOdc"/>
            </Subtrahends>
          </Subtract>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Total ODC from the CTC/ODC

It is derived and used for us to help the taxpayer make sense of how much of their credit comes from odc, but it does not exist directly on schedule 8812. ODC credits are applied before CTC credits as per the IRM and is also reduced first if there is a phase out.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/totalOdc">

  <Description>Total amount of ODC the TP will receive after the phaseout. It is derived and used for us to help the taxpayer make sense of how much of their credit comes from odc, but it does not exist directly on schedule 8812. ODC credits are applied before CTC credits as per the IRM and is also reduced first if there is a phase out.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Equal>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/totalCtcAndOdc"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </Equal>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>

</Fact>

facts.description: Whether the standard deduction is used, based on the taxpayer's choice and net benefit. Effectively, the only time we will *not* use the standard deduction is when non-MFS taxpayer wants to itemize, and their itemized deduction amount is greater than the standard deduction amount that they are eligible for. In all other cases, the standard deduction will be used.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/standardDeductionWillBeUsed">
  <Description>Whether the standard deduction is used, based on the taxpayer's choice and net benefit.
        Effectively, the only time we will *not* use the standard deduction is when non-MFS taxpayer wants to itemize,
        and their itemized deduction amount is greater than the standard deduction amount that they are eligible for.
        In all other cases, the standard deduction will be used.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFS"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/wantsStandardDeduction"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Not>
            <GreaterThan>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/itemizedDeduction"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Add>
                  <Dependency path="/standardDeduction"/>
                  <Dependency path="/nonItemizerCharitableContributionDeduction"/>
                </Add>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThan>
          </Not>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Qualified education expenses are amounts paid in TaxYear for tuition and fees required for the student’s enrollment or attendance at an eligible educational institution. It doesn’t matter whether the expenses were paid in cash, by check, by credit or debit card, or with borrowed funds.For course-related books, supplies, and equipment, only certain expenses qualify. -> American opportunity credit: Qualified education expenses include amounts paid for tuition, fees, and course materials, which include books, supplies, and equipment needed for a course of study, whether or not the materials are purchased from the educational institution as a condition of enrollment or attendance. -> Lifetime learning credit: Qualified education expenses include amounts paid for books, supplies, and equipment only if required to be paid to the institution as a condition of enrollment or attendance. https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i8863#en_US_2025_publink53002gd0e494

facts.description: The maximum amount of EITC that can be received based on the taxpayer's AGI.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/maxEitcFromAGI">
  <Description>The maximum amount of EITC that can be received based on the taxpayer's AGI.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Subtract>
      <Minuend>
        <Dependency path="/eitcMaxCredit"/>
      </Minuend>
      <Subtrahends>
        <Switch>
          <Case>
            <When>
              <GreaterThan>
                <Left>
                  <Add>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseOutThreshold"/>
                    <Dollar>25</Dollar>
                  </Add>
                </Left>
                <Right>
                  <Dependency path="/eitcRoundedAGI"/>
                </Right>
              </GreaterThan>
            </When>
            <Then>
              <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            </Then>
          </Case>
          <Case>
            <When>
              <True/>
            </When>
            <Then>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseOutRate"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcRoundedAGI"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseOutThreshold"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Then>
          </Case>
        </Switch>
      </Subtrahends>
    </Subtract>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Rounded earned income for EITC without combat pay
facts.description: In order to match the EITC table from Publication 596, we must round the income to match the rows, which use increments of $50, calculating the amount of the credit for the midpoint of row (i.e. $25, $75, $125, etc.).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/roundedEarnedIncome">
  <Name>Rounded earned income for EITC without combat pay</Name>
  <Description>In order to match the EITC table from Publication 596, we must round the income to match the rows,
        which use increments of $50, calculating the amount of the credit for the midpoint of row (i.e. $25, $75, $125,
        etc.).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <StepwiseMultiply>
        <Multiplicand>
          <Dependency path="/earnedIncomeTotal"/>
        </Multiplicand>
        <Rate>
          <Rational>50/50</Rational>
        </Rate>
      </StepwiseMultiply>
      <Dollar>25</Dollar>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

            </Right>

facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/eitcPhaseOutThreshold">
  <Name>EITC phaseout amount threshold</Name>
  <Description>The amount of income above which the amount of EITC begins to be reduced.
        Rev Proc .06 Earned Income
        Credit &#xA7;32(b)</Description>
  <TaxYear>2026</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Any>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusSingle"/>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusHOH"/>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusQSS"/>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFS"/>
          </Any>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Equal>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcQualifyingChildren"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Int>0</Int>
                  </Right>
                </Equal>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dollar>10860</Dollar>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <GreaterThanOrEqual>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcQualifyingChildren"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Int>1</Int>
                  </Right>
                </GreaterThanOrEqual>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dollar>23890</Dollar>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Equal>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcQualifyingChildren"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Int>0</Int>
                  </Right>
                </Equal>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dollar>18140</Dollar>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <GreaterThanOrEqual>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcQualifyingChildren"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Int>1</Int>
                  </Right>
                </GreaterThanOrEqual>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dollar>31160</Dollar>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

              </When>
              <Then>

                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/eitcQualifyingChildren"/>

facts.name: The amount of the Earned Income Tax Credit
facts.description: The amount of EITC, if the taxpayer is eligible. Magic numbers come from applicable Rev Procs, updated annually. Roughly matches /eitcAmountWithoutCombatPay in other, tax return filing forms
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/earnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>The amount of the Earned Income Tax Credit</Name>
  <Description>The amount of EITC, if the taxpayer is eligible. Magic numbers come from applicable Rev Procs, updated annually. Roughly matches /eitcAmountWithoutCombatPay in other, tax return filing forms</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/isEitcQualified"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <GreaterOf>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            <Round>
              <LesserOf>
                <Dependency path="/maxEitcFromAGI"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Switch>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <GreaterThanOrEqual>
                            <Left>
                              <Multiply>
                                <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseInRate"/>
                                <Add>
                                  <Dependency path="/roundedEarnedIncome"/>
                                  <Dollar>24</Dollar>
                                </Add>
                              </Multiply>
                            </Left>
                            <Right>
                              <Dependency path="/eitcMaxCredit"/>
                            </Right>
                          </GreaterThanOrEqual>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <Dependency path="/eitcMaxCredit"/>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <True/>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <LesserOf>
                            <Dependency path="/eitcMaxCredit"/>
                            <Multiply>
                              <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseInRate"/>
                              <Dependency path="/roundedEarnedIncome"/>
                            </Multiply>
                          </LesserOf>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                    </Switch>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Switch>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <GreaterThan>
                            <Left>
                              <Add>
                                <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseOutThreshold"/>
                                <Dollar>25</Dollar>
                              </Add>
                            </Left>
                            <Right>
                              <Dependency path="/roundedEarnedIncome"/>
                            </Right>
                          </GreaterThan>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <True/>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <Multiply>
                            <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseOutRate"/>
                            <Subtract>
                              <Minuend>
                                <LesserOf>
                                  <Dependency path="/roundedEarnedIncome"/>
                                  <Divide>
                                    <Dividend>
                                      <Add>
                                        <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseoutAmountLowerBound"/>
                                        <Dependency path="/eitcCompletedPhaseoutAmount"/>
                                      </Add>
                                    </Dividend>
                                    <Divisors>
                                      <Int>2</Int>
                                    </Divisors>
                                  </Divide>
                                </LesserOf>
                              </Minuend>
                              <Subtrahends>
                                <Dependency path="/eitcPhaseOutThreshold"/>
                              </Subtrahends>
                            </Subtract>
                          </Multiply>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                    </Switch>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </LesserOf>
            </Round>
          </GreaterOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

  <Derived>

      <Dependency path="/scheduleDLine16"/>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>

      <Dependency path="/netLongTermGainOrLoss"/>

              <Left>
                <Dollar>0</Dollar>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/scheduleDLine16"/>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThanOrEqual>
            <GreaterThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dollar>0</Dollar>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/scheduleDLine16"/>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThanOrEqual>
          </Any>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/netLongTermGainOrLoss"/>

facts.description: If the taxpayer is not in the tax bracket, /excessTaxableIncomeOverTopTaxBracket will be negative or zero so this fact will always be zero.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/amountOfItemizedDeductionsToSubtract">
  <Description>If the taxpayer is not in the tax bracket, /excessTaxableIncomeOverTopTaxBracket will be negative or zero so this fact will always be zero.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <GreaterOf>
        <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        <Multiply>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/excessTaxableIncomeOverTopTaxBracket"/>
            <Dependency path="/itemizedDeductionTotal"/>
          </LesserOf>
          <Rational>2/37</Rational>
        </Multiply>
      </GreaterOf>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Overtime Compensation Excluding Qualified Tip Overtime Comp
facts.description: This fraction is based on the /overtimeCompensationTotal fact, which is the amount of overtime compensation with the FLSA Overtime Premium NOT broken out. For an example, see the /jobs/*/overtimeCompensationTotal fact. Per notice 2025-69 (Page 23), the deductible portion of that total is 1/3 for a 1.5x overtime factor, and 1/4 for a 2x overtime factor. See: * https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/n-25-69.pdf * https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/treasury-irs-provide-guidance-for-individuals-who-received-tips-or-overtime-during-tax-year-2025
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/deductibleOvertimeCompensation">
  <Name>Overtime Compensation Excluding Qualified Tip Overtime Comp</Name>
  <Description>This fraction is based on the /overtimeCompensationTotal fact, which is the amount of overtime compensation with
        the FLSA Overtime Premium NOT broken out. For an example, see the /jobs/*/overtimeCompensationTotal fact.

        Per notice 2025-69 (Page 23), the deductible portion of that total is 1/3 for a 1.5x overtime factor, and 1/4
        for a 2x overtime factor.

        See:
         * https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/n-25-69.pdf
         * https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/treasury-irs-provide-guidance-for-individuals-who-received-tips-or-overtime-during-tax-year-2025</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Equal>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="../overtimeCompensationRate"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Enum optionsPath="/overtimeCompensationRateOptions">onePointFive</Enum>
            </Right>
          </Equal>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Rational>1/3</Rational>
            <Dependency path="../overtimeCompensationTotal"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Rational>1/4</Rational>
            <Dependency path="../overtimeCompensationTotal"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/effectiveMostRecentPayDate">

facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/averagePayPerPayPeriodForWithholding">
  <Description>Average pay per pay period used for withholding, consistent pay uses
        amountLastPaycheck minus most recent pay period bonus, while inconsistent pay uses
        inconsistentPayAverageExcludingBonus</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../consistentPay"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <GreaterOf>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <Dependency path="../amountLastPaycheck"/>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodBonusAmount"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
          </GreaterOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="../inconsistentPayAverageExcludingBonus"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/jobs/*/inconsistentPayAverage">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <IsComplete>
            <Dependency path="../pastPaycheckIncome3"/>
          </IsComplete>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Divide>
            <Dividend>
              <Add>
                <Dependency path="../pastPaycheckIncome1"/>
                <Dependency path="../pastPaycheckIncome2"/>
                <Dependency path="../pastPaycheckIncome3"/>
              </Add>
            </Dividend>
            <Divisors>
              <Int>3</Int>
            </Divisors>
          </Divide>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Divide>
            <Dividend>
              <Add>
                <Dependency path="../pastPaycheckIncome1"/>
                <Dependency path="../pastPaycheckIncome2"/>
              </Add>
            </Dividend>
            <Divisors>
              <Int>2</Int>
            </Divisors>
          </Divide>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/effectivePayPerPayPeriod">
  <Description>The effective pay per pay period for this job. For future jobs, this is derived from
        the user-entered expected salary or hourly rate since there is no pay history.
        For current and past jobs, this uses averagePayPerPayPeriodForWithholding which is
        based on actual pay stubs.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="../isInFuture"/>
            <Dependency path="../isHourlyJob"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Dependency path="../expectedFuturePayPerHour"/>
            <Dependency path="../hoursPerPayPeriod"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isInFuture"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Divide>
            <Dividend>
              <Dependency path="../expectedFutureAnnualSalary"/>
            </Dividend>
            <Divisors>
              <Dependency path="../payPeriodsPerYear"/>
            </Divisors>
          </Divide>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="../averagePayPerPayPeriodForWithholding"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: The average withholding from a specific job per pay period
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/averageWithholdingPerPayPeriod">
  <Description>The average withholding from a specific job per pay period</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="../consistentPay"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Divide>
              <Dividend>
                <Dependency path="../amountWithheldLastPaycheck"/>
              </Dividend>
              <Divisors>
                <Dependency path="../pastPaycheckIncome1"/>
              </Divisors>
            </Divide>
            <Dependency path="../inconsistentPayAverageExcludingBonus"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <GreaterThan>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodBonusAmount"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Dollar>0</Dollar>
                  </Right>
                </GreaterThan>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Multiply>
                  <Divide>
                    <Dividend>
                      <Dependency path="../amountWithheldLastPaycheck"/>
                    </Dividend>
                    <Divisors>
                      <Dependency path="../amountLastPaycheck"/>
                    </Divisors>
                  </Divide>
                  <Subtract>
                    <Minuend>
                      <Dependency path="../amountLastPaycheck"/>
                    </Minuend>
                    <Subtrahends>
                      <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodBonusAmount"/>
                    </Subtrahends>
                  </Subtract>
                </Multiply>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <True/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dependency path="../amountWithheldLastPaycheck"/>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

        <Then>

          <Divide>
            <Dividend>

            <Divisors>

            </Divisors>
          </Divide>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>

        </When>
        <Then>

facts.name: Taxpayer eligible for overtime compensation deduction
facts.description: Per Notice 2025-69, Taxpayers are ineligible for the qualified tip deduction if they are working a FLSA-exempt job or are Married Filing Separately. https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/n-25-69.pdf
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/isEligibleForOvertimeCompensationDeduction">
  <Name>Taxpayer eligible for overtime compensation deduction</Name>
  <Description>Per Notice 2025-69, Taxpayers are ineligible for the qualified tip deduction if they are
        working a FLSA-exempt job or are Married Filing Separately.
        https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/n-25-69.pdf</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFS"/>
      </Not>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/totalDeductibleOvertimeCompensation"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/overtimeCompensationDeductionExcessOverThreshold">
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency path="/magiForOB3BelowLineDeductions"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency path="/overtimeCompensationDeductionPhaseOutThreshold"/>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/overtimeCompensationDeductionPhaseOutThreshold">

</Fact>

facts.name: Qualified Overtime Deduction Phase Out
facts.description: The amount allowable as a deduction under shall be reduced (but not below zero) by $100 for each $1,000 by which the taxpayer’s MAGI exceeds $150,000 ($300,000 in the case of a joint return).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/overtimeCompensationDeductionPhaseOut">
  <Name>Qualified Overtime Deduction Phase Out</Name>
  <Description>The amount allowable as a deduction under shall be reduced (but not below zero) by $100 for each
        $1,000 by which the taxpayer&#x2019;s MAGI exceeds $150,000 ($300,000 in the case of a joint return).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <StepwiseMultiply>
      <Multiplicand>
        <Dependency path="/overtimeCompensationDeductionExcessOverThreshold"/>
      </Multiplicand>
      <Rate>
        <Rational>100/1000</Rational>
      </Rate>
    </StepwiseMultiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Overtime Compensation Deduction
facts.description: Example: Single filer with 160k MAGI and 10k deductible overtime compensations. 150k applicable overtime compensation threshold (20,000 excess/1000)*100 = 2,000 phase out 10,000 overtime comp - 2,000 phase out = 8,000 applicable deduction
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/overtimeCompensationDeduction">
  <Name>Overtime Compensation Deduction</Name>
  <Description>Example: Single filer with 160k MAGI and 10k deductible overtime compensations.
        150k applicable overtime compensation threshold (20,000 excess/1000)*100 = 2,000 phase out
        10,000 overtime comp - 2,000 phase out = 8,000 applicable deduction</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency path="/isEligibleForOvertimeCompensationDeduction"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <LesserOf>
                  <Dependency path="/totalDeductibleOvertimeCompensation"/>
                  <Dependency path="/overtimeCompensationDeductionMax"/>
                </LesserOf>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="/overtimeCompensationDeductionPhaseOut"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: A preliminary calculation of remaining pay periods for weekly and biweekly frequencies, to be adjusted because it may extend past the end of the year.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/tentativeRemainingPayPeriods">
  <Description>A preliminary calculation of remaining pay periods for weekly and biweekly
        frequencies, to be adjusted because it may extend past the end of the year.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Any>
            <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyWeekly"/>
            <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyBiWeekly"/>
          </Any>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Ceiling>
            <Divide>
              <Dividend>
                <Switch>
                  <Case>
                    <When>
                      <Dependency path="../hasLaggingPaymentsFromPriorYear"/>
                    </When>
                    <Then>
                      <Add>
                        <Subtract>
                          <Minuend>
                            <Dependency path="/daysInPriorYear"/>
                          </Minuend>
                          <Subtrahends>
                            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/ordinal"/>
                          </Subtrahends>
                        </Subtract>
                        <Dependency path="../endDate/ordinal"/>
                      </Add>
                    </Then>
                  </Case>
                  <Case>
                    <When>
                      <True/>
                    </When>
                    <Then>
                      <Subtract>
                        <Minuend>
                          <Dependency path="../endDate/ordinal"/>
                        </Minuend>
                        <Subtrahends>
                          <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/ordinal"/>
                        </Subtrahends>
                      </Subtract>
                    </Then>
                  </Case>
                </Switch>
              </Dividend>
              <Divisors>
                <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
              </Divisors>
            </Divide>
          </Ceiling>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: The month in which the user last worked as far as income counting towards this year is concerned, used for semi-monthly and monthly
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/effectiveEndDate">
  <Description>The month in which the user last worked as far as income counting towards this
        year is concerned, used for semi-monthly and monthly</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <AddPayrollMonths>
            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd"/>
            <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
          </AddPayrollMonths>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Equal>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                  </Right>
                </Equal>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <AddPayrollMonths>
                  <Switch>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <Equal>
                          <Left>
                            <Modulo>
                              <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                              <Int>2</Int>
                            </Modulo>
                          </Left>
                          <Right>
                            <Int>0</Int>
                          </Right>
                        </Equal>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <True/>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                  </Switch>
                  <Floor>
                    <Divide>
                      <Dividend>
                        <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                      </Dividend>
                      <Divisors>
                        <Int>2</Int>
                      </Divisors>
                    </Divide>
                  </Floor>
                </AddPayrollMonths>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Equal>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                  </Right>
                </Equal>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <AddPayrollMonths>
                  <Switch>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <Equal>
                          <Left>
                            <Modulo>
                              <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                              <Int>2</Int>
                            </Modulo>
                          </Left>
                          <Right>
                            <Int>0</Int>
                          </Right>
                        </Equal>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <True/>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                  </Switch>
                  <Ceiling>
                    <Divide>
                      <Dividend>
                        <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                      </Dividend>
                      <Divisors>
                        <Int>2</Int>
                      </Divisors>
                    </Divide>
                  </Ceiling>
                </AddPayrollMonths>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

      <Case>
        <When>

          <Add>
            <Switch>
              <Case>

            <Case>

facts.description: Calculated as a combined number/decimal value.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/futurePartialPayPeriods">
  <Description>Calculated as a combined number/decimal value.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Any>
            <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyWeekly"/>
            <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyBiWeekly"/>
          </Any>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Divide>
            <Dividend>
              <Subtract>
                <Minuend>
                  <Dependency path="../endDate/ordinal"/>
                </Minuend>
                <Subtrahends>
                  <Dependency path="../startDate/ordinal"/>
                </Subtrahends>
              </Subtract>
            </Dividend>
            <Divisors>
              <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
            </Divisors>
          </Divide>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Add>
            <Divide>
              <Dividend>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency path="../lastDayOfStartMonth/day"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency path="../zeroIndexedStartDay"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Dividend>
              <Divisors>
                <Dependency path="../lastDayOfStartMonth/day"/>
              </Divisors>
            </Divide>
            <Switch>
              <Case>
                <When>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Int>12</Int>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                </When>
                <Then>
                  <Rational>0/1</Rational>
                </Then>
              </Case>
              <Case>
                <When>
                  <True/>
                </When>
                <Then>
                  <Divide>
                    <Dividend>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                    </Dividend>
                    <Divisors>
                      <Dependency path="../lastDayOfEndMonth/day"/>
                    </Divisors>
                  </Divide>
                </Then>
              </Case>
            </Switch>
            <GreaterOf>
              <Subtract>
                <Minuend>
                  <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                </Minuend>
                <Subtrahends>
                  <Dependency path="../startDate/month"/>
                  <Int>1</Int>
                </Subtrahends>
              </Subtract>
              <Int>0</Int>
            </GreaterOf>
          </Add>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Add>
            <Divide>
              <Dividend>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <LesserOf>
                      <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                      <Dependency path="../zeroIndexedStartDay"/>
                    </LesserOf>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Dividend>
              <Divisors>
                <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
              </Divisors>
            </Divide>
            <Divide>
              <Dividend>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency path="../lastDayOfStartMonth/day"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <GreaterOf>
                      <Dependency path="../zeroIndexedStartDay"/>
                      <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                    </GreaterOf>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Dividend>
              <Divisors>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency path="../lastDayOfStartMonth/day"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Divisors>
            </Divide>
            <Divide>
              <Dividend>
                <LesserOf>
                  <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                  <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                </LesserOf>
              </Dividend>
              <Divisors>
                <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
              </Divisors>
            </Divide>
            <Switch>
              <Case>
                <When>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Int>12</Int>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                </When>
                <Then>
                  <Rational>0/1</Rational>
                </Then>
              </Case>
              <Case>
                <When>
                  <True/>
                </When>
                <Then>
                  <Divide>
                    <Dividend>
                      <GreaterOf>
                        <Subtract>
                          <Minuend>
                            <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                          </Minuend>
                          <Subtrahends>
                            <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                          </Subtrahends>
                        </Subtract>
                        <Int>0</Int>
                      </GreaterOf>
                    </Dividend>
                    <Divisors>
                      <Subtract>
                        <Minuend>
                          <Dependency path="../lastDayOfEndMonth/day"/>
                        </Minuend>
                        <Subtrahends>
                          <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                        </Subtrahends>
                      </Subtract>
                    </Divisors>
                  </Divide>
                </Then>
              </Case>
            </Switch>
            <Multiply>
              <Int>2</Int>
              <GreaterOf>
                <Int>0</Int>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency path="../startDate/month"/>
                    <Int>1</Int>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
                <Int>0</Int>
              </GreaterOf>
            </Multiply>
          </Add>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: The number of pay periods remaining in the year. If the taxpayer is only working for part of their final pay period, that pay period is included Monthly and semimonthly are computed directly. Weekly and biweekly are computed using `../tentativeRemainingPayPeriods` and `../predictedOrdinalFinalPayDate` to make any necessary adjustment when the tentative calculation overflows the end of year. For example, let's say you are paid weekly every Friday for the previous week, and you're working through EOY. Then (in 2025) you will be paid on the 2nd of January 2026 for 12/21-27, and on the 9th of January 2026 for 12/28-01/03. That's two pay periods that are in 2025 that will be paid for (and taxed in) 2026.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/remainingPayPeriodsInteger">
  <Description>The number of pay periods remaining in the year. If the taxpayer is only working for part of
        their final pay period, that pay period is included

        Monthly and semimonthly are computed directly.

        Weekly and biweekly are computed using `../tentativeRemainingPayPeriods` and
        `../predictedOrdinalFinalPayDate` to make any necessary adjustment when the tentative
        calculation overflows the end of year.

        For example, let's say you are paid weekly every Friday for the previous week, and you're
        working through EOY. Then (in 2025) you will be paid on the 2nd of January 2026 for
        12/21-27, and on the 9th of January 2026 for 12/28-01/03. That's two pay periods that are in
        2025 that will be paid for (and taxed in) 2026.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isInFuture"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Ceiling>
            <Dependency path="../futurePartialPayPeriods"/>
          </Ceiling>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPastJob"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>0</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <Int>12</Int>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="../effectiveMostRecentPayDate/month"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
            <Add>
              <Subtract>
                <Minuend>
                  <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                </Minuend>
                <Subtrahends>
                  <Switch>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <Dependency path="../hasLaggingPaymentsFromPriorYear"/>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Int>0</Int>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <True/>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/month"/>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                  </Switch>
                </Subtrahends>
              </Subtract>
              <Switch>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <All>
                      <GreaterThan>
                        <Left>
                          <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                        </Left>
                        <Right>
                          <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/day"/>
                        </Right>
                      </GreaterThan>
                      <NotEqual>
                        <Left>
                          <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                        </Left>
                        <Right>
                          <Int>12</Int>
                        </Right>
                      </NotEqual>
                      <Not>
                        <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEndIsOnLastDayOfMonth"/>
                      </Not>
                    </All>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Int>1</Int>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <True/>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Int>0</Int>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
              </Switch>
              <Switch>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <Dependency path="../hasLaggingPaymentsFromPriorYear"/>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Subtract>
                      <Minuend>
                        <Int>12</Int>
                      </Minuend>
                      <Subtrahends>
                        <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/month"/>
                      </Subtrahends>
                    </Subtract>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <True/>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Int>0</Int>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
              </Switch>
            </Add>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Add>
              <Multiply>
                <Int>2</Int>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Int>12</Int>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency path="../effectiveMostRecentPayDate/month"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
              <Count>
                <LessThanOrEqual>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="../effectiveMostRecentPayDate/day"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Int>15</Int>
                  </Right>
                </LessThanOrEqual>
              </Count>
            </Add>
            <Add>
              <Count>
                <All>
                  <NotEqual>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/month"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                    </Right>
                  </NotEqual>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                  <Not>
                    <Dependency path="../hasLaggingPaymentsFromPriorYear"/>
                  </Not>
                </All>
              </Count>
              <GreaterOf>
                <Int>0</Int>
                <Multiply>
                  <Int>2</Int>
                  <Subtract>
                    <Minuend>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                    </Minuend>
                    <Subtrahends>
                      <Switch>
                        <Case>
                          <When>
                            <Dependency path="../hasLaggingPaymentsFromPriorYear"/>
                          </When>
                          <Then>
                            <Int>0</Int>
                          </Then>
                        </Case>
                        <Case>
                          <When>
                            <True/>
                          </When>
                          <Then>
                            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/month"/>
                          </Then>
                        </Case>
                      </Switch>
                      <Int>1</Int>
                    </Subtrahends>
                  </Subtract>
                </Multiply>
              </GreaterOf>
              <Switch>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <All>
                      <Not>
                        <Dependency path="../hasLaggingPaymentsFromPriorYear"/>
                      </Not>
                      <Equal>
                        <Left>
                          <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/month"/>
                        </Left>
                        <Right>
                          <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                        </Right>
                      </Equal>
                    </All>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Count>
                      <All>
                        <Equal>
                          <Left>
                            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd"/>
                          </Left>
                          <Right>
                            <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                          </Right>
                        </Equal>
                        <GreaterThan>
                          <Left>
                            <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                          </Left>
                          <Right>
                            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/day"/>
                          </Right>
                        </GreaterThan>
                      </All>
                    </Count>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <True/>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Switch>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <LessThanOrEqual>
                            <Left>
                              <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                            </Left>
                            <Right>
                              <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd/day"/>
                            </Right>
                          </LessThanOrEqual>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <Int>1</Int>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <GreaterThan>
                            <Left>
                              <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                            </Left>
                            <Right>
                              <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd/day"/>
                            </Right>
                          </GreaterThan>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <Int>2</Int>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <True/>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <Int>0</Int>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                    </Switch>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
              </Switch>
              <Count>
                <All>
                  <GreaterThan>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd/day"/>
                    </Right>
                  </GreaterThan>
                  <NotEqual>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Int>12</Int>
                    </Right>
                  </NotEqual>
                  <NotEqual>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <LastDayOfMonth>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                      </LastDayOfMonth>
                    </Right>
                  </NotEqual>
                </All>
              </Count>
              <Switch>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <Dependency path="../hasLaggingPaymentsFromPriorYear"/>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Add>
                      <Multiply>
                        <Subtract>
                          <Minuend>
                            <Int>12</Int>
                          </Minuend>
                          <Subtrahends>
                            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd/month"/>
                          </Subtrahends>
                        </Subtract>
                        <Int>2</Int>
                      </Multiply>
                      <Count>
                        <Equal>
                          <Left>
                            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodEnd"/>
                          </Left>
