facts.description: The number of pay periods remaining in the year. If the taxpayer is only working for part of their final pay period, that pay period is included Monthly and semimonthly are computed directly. Weekly and biweekly are computed using `../tentativeRemainingPayPeriods` and `../predictedOrdinalFinalPayDate` to make any necessary adjustment when the tentative calculation overflows the end of year. For example, let's say you are paid weekly every Friday for the previous week, and you're working through EOY. Then (in 2025) you will be paid on the 2nd of January 2026 for 12/21-27, and on the 9th of January 2026 for 12/28-01/03. That's two pay periods that are in 2025 that will be paid for (and taxed in) 2026.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/remainingPayPeriodsInteger">
  <Description>The number of pay periods remaining in the year. If the taxpayer is only working for part of
        their final pay period, that pay period is included

        Monthly and semimonthly are computed directly.

        Weekly and biweekly are computed using `../tentativeRemainingPayPeriods` and
        `../predictedOrdinalFinalPayDate` to make any necessary adjustment when the tentative
        calculation overflows the end of year.

        For example, let's say you are paid weekly every Friday for the previous week, and you're
        working through EOY. Then (in 2025) you will be paid on the 2nd of January 2026 for
        12/21-27, and on the 9th of January 2026 for 12/28-01/03. That's two pay periods that are in
        2025 that will be paid for (and taxed in) 2026.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPastJob"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>0</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isInFuture"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <PayrollMonthsBetween>
                  <StartDate>
                    <Dependency path="../startDate"/>
                  </StartDate>
                  <EndDate>
                    <Dependency path="../endDate"/>
                  </EndDate>
                </PayrollMonthsBetween>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Add>
                  <Multiply>
                    <Dependency path="../payrollMonthsBetweenStartAndEndMinus1"/>
                    <Int>2</Int>
                  </Multiply>
                  <Ceiling>
                    <Divide>
                      <Dividend>
                        <Subtract>
                          <Minuend>
                            <Dependency path="../endDate"/>
                          </Minuend>
                          <Subtrahends>
                            <AddPayrollMonths>
                              <Dependency path="../startDate"/>
                              <Dependency path="../payrollMonthsBetweenStartAndEndMinus1"/>
                            </AddPayrollMonths>
                          </Subtrahends>
                        </Subtract>
                      </Dividend>
                      <Divisors>
                        <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                      </Divisors>
                    </Divide>
                  </Ceiling>
                </Add>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <True/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Ceiling>
                  <Divide>
                    <Dividend>
                      <Subtract>
                        <Minuend>
                          <Dependency path="../endDate/ordinal"/>
                        </Minuend>
                        <Subtrahends>
                          <Dependency path="../startDate/ordinal"/>
                        </Subtrahends>
                      </Subtract>
                    </Dividend>
                    <Divisors>
                      <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                    </Divisors>
                  </Divide>
                </Ceiling>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <Int>12</Int>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/month"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
            <Add>
              <Subtract>
                <Minuend>
                  <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                </Minuend>
                <Subtrahends>
                  <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/month"/>
                </Subtrahends>
              </Subtract>
              <Switch>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <All>
                      <GreaterThan>
                        <Left>
                          <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                        </Left>
                        <Right>
                          <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/day"/>
                        </Right>
                      </GreaterThan>
                      <NotEqual>
                        <Left>
                          <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                        </Left>
                        <Right>
                          <Int>12</Int>
                        </Right>
                      </NotEqual>
                      <Not>
                        <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDateIsOnLastDayOfMonth"/>
                      </Not>
                    </All>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Int>1</Int>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <True/>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Int>0</Int>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
              </Switch>
            </Add>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Add>
              <Multiply>
                <Int>2</Int>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Int>12</Int>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/month"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
              <Count>
                <LessThanOrEqual>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/day"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Int>15</Int>
                  </Right>
                </LessThanOrEqual>
              </Count>
            </Add>
            <Add>
              <Count>
                <All>
                  <NotEqual>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/month"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                    </Right>
                  </NotEqual>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                </All>
              </Count>
              <GreaterOf>
                <Int>0</Int>
                <Multiply>
                  <Int>2</Int>
                  <Subtract>
                    <Minuend>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                    </Minuend>
                    <Subtrahends>
                      <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/month"/>
                      <Int>1</Int>
                    </Subtrahends>
                  </Subtract>
                </Multiply>
              </GreaterOf>
              <Switch>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <All>
                      <Equal>
                        <Left>
                          <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/month"/>
                        </Left>
                        <Right>
                          <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                        </Right>
                      </Equal>
                    </All>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Count>
                      <All>
                        <Equal>
                          <Left>
                            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
                          </Left>
                          <Right>
                            <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                          </Right>
                        </Equal>
                        <GreaterThan>
                          <Left>
                            <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                          </Left>
                          <Right>
                            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/day"/>
                          </Right>
                        </GreaterThan>
                      </All>
                    </Count>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
                <Case>
                  <When>
                    <True/>
                  </When>
                  <Then>
                    <Switch>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <LessThanOrEqual>
                            <Left>
                              <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                            </Left>
                            <Right>
                              <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd/day"/>
                            </Right>
                          </LessThanOrEqual>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <Int>1</Int>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <GreaterThan>
                            <Left>
                              <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                            </Left>
                            <Right>
                              <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd/day"/>
                            </Right>
                          </GreaterThan>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <Int>2</Int>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                      <Case>
                        <When>
                          <True/>
                        </When>
                        <Then>
                          <Int>0</Int>
                        </Then>
                      </Case>
                    </Switch>
                  </Then>
                </Case>
              </Switch>
              <Count>
                <All>
                  <GreaterThan>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/day"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd/day"/>
                    </Right>
                  </GreaterThan>
                  <NotEqual>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../endDate/month"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Int>12</Int>
                    </Right>
                  </NotEqual>
                  <NotEqual>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <LastDayOfMonth>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                      </LastDayOfMonth>
                    </Right>
                  </NotEqual>
                </All>
              </Count>
            </Add>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <GreaterThan>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="../predictedOrdinalFinalPayDate"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dependency path="/daysInYear"/>
            </Right>
          </GreaterThan>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Subtract>
            <Minuend>
              <Dependency path="../tentativeRemainingPayPeriods"/>
            </Minuend>
            <Subtrahends>
              <Ceiling>
                <Divide>
                  <Dividend>
                    <Subtract>
                      <Minuend>
                        <Dependency path="../predictedOrdinalFinalPayDate"/>
                      </Minuend>
                      <Subtrahends>
                        <Dependency path="/daysInYear"/>
                      </Subtrahends>
                    </Subtract>
                  </Dividend>
                  <Divisors>
                    <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                  </Divisors>
                </Divide>
              </Ceiling>
            </Subtrahends>
          </Subtract>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="../tentativeRemainingPayPeriods"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>

facts.description: The month in which the user last worked as far as income counting towards this year is concerned, used for semi-monthly and monthly
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/effectiveEndDate">
  <Description>The month in which the user last worked as far as income counting towards this
        year is concerned, used for semi-monthly and monthly</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <AddPayrollMonths>
            <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
            <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
          </AddPayrollMonths>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Equal>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                  </Right>
                </Equal>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <AddPayrollMonths>
                  <Switch>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <Equal>
                          <Left>
                            <Modulo>
                              <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                              <Int>2</Int>
                            </Modulo>
                          </Left>
                          <Right>
                            <Int>0</Int>
                          </Right>
                        </Equal>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <True/>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                  </Switch>
                  <Floor>
                    <Divide>
                      <Dividend>
                        <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                      </Dividend>
                      <Divisors>
                        <Int>2</Int>
                      </Divisors>
                    </Divide>
                  </Floor>
                </AddPayrollMonths>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Equal>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                  </Right>
                </Equal>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <AddPayrollMonths>
                  <Switch>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <Equal>
                          <Left>
                            <Modulo>
                              <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                              <Int>2</Int>
                            </Modulo>
                          </Left>
                          <Right>
                            <Int>0</Int>
                          </Right>
                        </Equal>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPeriodEnd"/>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                    <Case>
                      <When>
                        <True/>
                      </When>
                      <Then>
                        <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPeriodEnd"/>
                      </Then>
                    </Case>
                  </Switch>
                  <Ceiling>
                    <Divide>
                      <Dividend>
                        <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                      </Dividend>
                      <Divisors>
                        <Int>2</Int>
                      </Divisors>
                    </Divide>
                  </Ceiling>
                </AddPayrollMonths>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Is paid for a partial partial period
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/hasPartialPayPeriod">
  <Description>Is paid for a partial partial period</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isInFuture"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <GreaterThan>
                  <Left>
                    <AddPayrollMonths>
                      <Dependency path="../startDate"/>
                      <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                    </AddPayrollMonths>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Dependency path="../endDate"/>
                  </Right>
                </GreaterThan>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <NotEqual>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="../extraDaysInLastPeriodForSemiMonthly"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Int>0</Int>
                  </Right>
                </NotEqual>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <True/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <GreaterThan>
                  <Left>
                    <Add>
                      <Dependency path="../startDate/ordinal"/>
                      <Multiply>
                        <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsInteger"/>
                        <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                      </Multiply>
                    </Add>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Dependency path="../endDate/ordinal"/>
                  </Right>
                </GreaterThan>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LessThan>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="../endDate/ordinal"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dependency path="../ordinalEffectiveEndDate"/>
            </Right>
          </LessThan>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: The fractional amount of remaining pay periods, for use in calculating resulting eoy total income.

<Fact path="/pensions/*/partialPayPeriods">

        eoy total income.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPastJob"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Rational>0/1</Rational>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="../isInFuture"/>
            <Dependency path="../hasPartialPayPeriod"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Divide>
                  <Dividend>
                    <Subtract>
                      <Minuend>
                        <Dependency path="../endDate"/>
                      </Minuend>
                      <Subtrahends>
                        <AddPayrollMonths>
                          <Dependency path="../startDate"/>
                          <Dependency path="../fullPayPeriods"/>
                        </AddPayrollMonths>
                      </Subtrahends>
                    </Subtract>
                  </Dividend>
                  <Divisors>
                    <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                  </Divisors>
                </Divide>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Divide>
                  <Dividend>
                    <Dependency path="../extraDaysInLastPeriodForSemiMonthly"/>
                  </Dividend>
                  <Divisors>
                    <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                  </Divisors>
                </Divide>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <True/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Divide>
                  <Dividend>
                    <Subtract>
                      <Minuend>
                        <Dependency path="../endDate/ordinal"/>
                      </Minuend>
                      <Subtrahends>
                        <Add>
                          <Dependency path="../startDate/ordinal"/>
                          <Multiply>
                            <Dependency path="../fullPayPeriods"/>
                            <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                          </Multiply>
                        </Add>
                      </Subtrahends>
                    </Subtract>
                  </Dividend>
                  <Divisors>
                    <Dependency path="../payPeriodLength"/>
                  </Divisors>
                </Divide>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="../currentPartialPayPeriods"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: For semimonthly pay periods, determines the earlier pay date, we assume pay dates of the 16 correspond to pay dates on the 1st
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/semimonthlyEarlierPayDate">
  <Description>For semimonthly pay periods, determines the earlier pay date, we assume pay dates of the 16 correspond to pay dates on the 1st</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <GreaterThan>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/day"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Int>15</Int>
            </Right>
          </GreaterThan>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Subtract>
            <Minuend>
              <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
            </Minuend>
            <Subtrahends>
              <Days>15</Days>
            </Subtrahends>
          </Subtract>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: For semimonthly pay periods, determines the later pay date
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/semimonthlyLaterPayDate">
  <Description>For semimonthly pay periods, determines the later pay date</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThanOrEqual>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/day"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Int>15</Int>
            </Right>
          </LessThanOrEqual>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <All>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/month"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Int>2</Int>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                  <Any>
                    <Equal>
                      <Left>
                        <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/day"/>
                      </Left>
                      <Right>
                        <Int>14</Int>
                      </Right>
                    </Equal>
                    <Equal>
                      <Left>
                        <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate/day"/>
                      </Left>
                      <Right>
                        <Int>15</Int>
                      </Right>
                    </Equal>
                  </Any>
                </All>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <LastDayOfMonth>
                  <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
                </LastDayOfMonth>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <True/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Add>
                  <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
                  <Days>15</Days>
                </Add>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/pensions/*/nextPayDay">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Equal>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPayDate"/>
            </Right>
          </Equal>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="../semimonthlyLaterPayDate"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <AddPayrollMonths>
            <Dependency path="../semimonthlyEarlierPayDate"/>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </AddPayrollMonths>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/pensions/*/payPeriodsBeforeW4ChangesAppear">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isInFuture"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>0</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyWeekly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>2</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyBiWeekly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>1</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <GreaterThanOrEqual>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/projectedW4EffectDate"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <AddPayrollMonths>
                      <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
                      <Int>1</Int>
                    </AddPayrollMonths>
                  </Right>
                </GreaterThanOrEqual>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Int>2</Int>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <GreaterThanOrEqual>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/projectedW4EffectDate"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Dependency path="../nextPayDay"/>
                  </Right>
                </GreaterThanOrEqual>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Int>1</Int>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <True/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Int>0</Int>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Count>
            <GreaterThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/projectedW4EffectDate"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <AddPayrollMonths>
                  <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayDate"/>
                  <Int>1</Int>
                </AddPayrollMonths>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThanOrEqual>
          </Count>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/pensions/*/isPastJob">
  <Derived>
    <LessThanOrEqual>
      <Left>
        <Dependency path="../endDate"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Dependency path="/today"/>
      </Right>
    </LessThanOrEqual>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/pensions/*/isCurrentJob">
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <LessThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/today"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency path="../endDate"/>
        </Right>
      </LessThan>
      <GreaterThanOrEqual>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/today"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency path="../startDate"/>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThanOrEqual>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/pensions/*/isInFuture">
  <Derived>
    <LessThan>
      <Left>
        <Dependency path="/today"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Dependency path="../startDate"/>
      </Right>
    </LessThan>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/pensions/*/restOfYearIncome">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPastJob"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Dependency path="../averagePayPerPayPeriodForWithholding"/>
            <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsRational"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: The pension income before pretax deductions. This is usually not the fact you want in tax calculations, it's used for displaying a pension's total income in a way that matches taxpayer expectations.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/grossIncome">

facts.description: The amount that will be withheld in the time between today and when the W-4 is expected to be processed.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/lagWithholding">
  <Description>The amount that will be withheld in the time between today and when the W-4 is expected to
        be processed.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="../isCurrentJob"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Dependency path="../averageWithholdingPerPayPeriod"/>
            <LesserOf>
              <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsRational"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency path="../payPeriodsBeforeW4ChangesAppear"/>
                <Rational>1/1</Rational>
              </Multiply>
            </LesserOf>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Future tentative withholding: result from Pub 15-T Worksheet 1A For now, we treat this as a "given" that won't change. Probably will need to revisit this when we get to reducing below tentative withholding.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/futureTentativeWithholding">
  <Description>Future tentative withholding: result from Pub 15-T Worksheet 1A
        For now, we treat this as a "given" that won't change. Probably will need to revisit
        this when we get to reducing below tentative withholding.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPastJob"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isInFuture"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Divide>
              <Dividend>
                <Dependency path="../tentativeAnnualWithholdingAmount"/>
              </Dividend>
              <Divisors>
                <Dependency path="../payPeriodsPerYear"/>
              </Divisors>
            </Divide>
            <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsRational"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Divide>
              <Dividend>
                <Dependency path="../tentativeAnnualWithholdingAmount"/>
              </Dividend>
              <Divisors>
                <Dependency path="../payPeriodsPerYear"/>
              </Divisors>
            </Divide>
            <GreaterOf>
              <Rational>0/1</Rational>
              <Subtract>
                <Minuend>
                  <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsRational"/>
                </Minuend>
                <Subtrahends>
                  <Multiply>
                    <Dependency path="../payPeriodsBeforeW4ChangesAppear"/>
                    <Rational>1/1</Rational>
                  </Multiply>
                </Subtrahends>
              </Subtract>
            </GreaterOf>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: The total amount that will be withheld from the paycheck if the W-4 is submitted today with no additional withholdings. This is also referred to as the "do-nothing withholding."
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/committedWithholding">
  <Description>The total amount that will be withheld from the paycheck if the W-4 is submitted today with

<Fact path="/pensionsTotalCommittedWithholding">

    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>

        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>

        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Dependency path="../remainingPayPeriodsRational"/>

  </Derived>

          <CollectionSize>

<Fact path="/form8995aLine13">
  <Description>The following simplifying assumption was made for user convenience: if there is no phase in, use the tentative QBI Component. If there is any phase in (positive or negative), use that instead.</Description>
  <Derived>

<Fact path="/form8995aLine26">

</Fact>

facts.name: Derived Qualified Business Income Deduction
facts.description: Section 199A: qualified business income deduction. The deduction allows eligible taxpayers to deduct up to 20 percent of their QBI, plus 20 percent of qualified real estate investment trust (REIT) dividends and qualified publicly traded partnership (PTP) income. Income earned through a C corporation or by providing services as an employee is not eligible for the deduction. For more information on what qualifies as a trade or business, see Determining your qualified trades or businesses in the Instructions for Form 8995-A or Form 8995.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/derivedQualifiedBusinessIncomeDeduction">
  <Name>Derived Qualified Business Income Deduction</Name>
  <Description>Section 199A: qualified business income deduction. The deduction allows eligible
            taxpayers to deduct up to 20 percent of their QBI, plus 20 percent of qualified real estate
            investment trust (REIT) dividends and qualified publicly traded partnership (PTP) income.
            Income earned through a C corporation or by providing services as an employee is not
            eligible for the deduction. For more information on what qualifies as a trade or business,
            see Determining your qualified trades or businesses in the Instructions for Form 8995-A or
            Form 8995.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/isEligibleForApplicableTaxpayerQBIDeduction"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/tentativeQualifiedBusinessIncomeDeduction"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <GreaterOf>
            <Dependency path="/minimumDeductionForActiveQBIAmount"/>
            <Dependency path="/tentativeQualifiedBusinessIncomeDeduction"/>
          </GreaterOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Qualified Tip Deduction Phase Out
facts.description: The amount allowable as a deduction under shall be reduced (but not below zero) by $100 for each $1,000 by which the taxpayer’s MAGI exceeds $150,000 ($300,000 in the case of a joint return).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/qualifiedTipDeductionPhaseOut">
  <Name>Qualified Tip Deduction Phase Out</Name>
  <Description>The amount allowable as a deduction under shall be reduced (but not
        below zero) by $100 for each $1,000 by which the
        taxpayer&#x2019;s MAGI exceeds $150,000 ($300,000 in the case of a joint return).</Description>
  <TaxYear>2026</TaxYear>
  <Derived>

        <Dependency path="/qualifiedTipDeductionExcessOverThreshold"/>

      </Rate>
    </StepwiseMultiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Qualified tip deduction
facts.description: Qualified tip deductions Example: Single filer with 160k MAGI and 20k qualified tips. 150k applicable tip deduction threshold (20,000 excess/1000)*100 = 2,000 phase out 20,000 tip - 2,000 phase out = 18,000 applicable deduction
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/qualifiedTipDeduction">
  <Name>Qualified tip deduction</Name>
  <Description>Qualified tip deductions
        Example:
        Single filer with 160k MAGI and 20k qualified tips. 150k applicable tip deduction threshold
        (20,000 excess/1000)*100 = 2,000 phase out
        20,000 tip - 2,000 phase out = 18,000 applicable deduction</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency path="/isEligibleForQualifiedTipDeduction"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <LesserOf>
                  <Dependency path="/qualifiedTipIncome"/>
                  <Dependency path="/maxQualifiedTipDeductionAmount"/>
                </LesserOf>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="/qualifiedTipDeductionPhaseOut"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/qualifiedTipDeductionPhaseOutThreshold">
  <TaxYear>2026</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>

        </When>

        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>

        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Self-employed retirement plan deduction. facts.rawXml:

facts.name: Senior Deduction Secondary Filer Eligibility
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/eligibleTaxpayersForSeniorDeduction">
  <Name>Senior Deduction Secondary Filer Eligibility</Name>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
            <Dependency path="/primaryFilerAge65OrOlder"/>
            <Dependency path="/secondaryFilerAge65OrOlder"/>
            <Dependency path="/primaryTaxpayerElectsForSeniorDeduction"/>
            <Dependency path="/secondaryTaxpayerElectsForSeniorDeduction"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>2</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
            <Any>
              <All>
                <Dependency path="/primaryFilerAge65OrOlder"/>
                <Dependency path="/primaryTaxpayerElectsForSeniorDeduction"/>
              </All>
              <All>
                <Dependency path="/secondaryFilerAge65OrOlder"/>
                <Dependency path="/secondaryTaxpayerElectsForSeniorDeduction"/>
              </All>
            </Any>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>1</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
            <Not>
              <Dependency path="/primaryFilerAge65OrOlder"/>
            </Not>
            <Not>
              <Dependency path="/secondaryFilerAge65OrOlder"/>
            </Not>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>0</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/primaryFilerAge65OrOlder"/>
            <Dependency path="/primaryTaxpayerElectsForSeniorDeduction"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>1</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <Dependency path="/secondaryFilerAge65OrOlder"/>
            <Dependency path="/secondaryTaxpayerElectsForSeniorDeduction"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>1</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>0</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Threshold when taxable portion of SSA Benefits changes from 0% to 50%. Pub 915 Worksheet 1, Line 9. If SSA MAGI (Line 8) is less than $32K for MFJ and $25K for anybody else, 0% of SSA benefits are taxed. This is our bracket zero. Taxable portion of SSA MAGI which is more than bracket zero but less than $32K + $12K for MFJ and $25K + $9K for everyone else, is 50%, not to exceed 50% of SSA Benefits total. Taxable portion of SSA MAGI which is more than $32K + $12K for MFJ and $25K + $9K for everyone else, is 85%, not to exceed 85% of SSA Benefits total. If TP is MFS which lived together for any part of the year, all SSA Benefits are taxed at 85%.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pub915BracketZeroLine9">
  <Description>Threshold when taxable portion of SSA Benefits changes from 0% to 50%. Pub 915
        Worksheet 1, Line 9.
        If SSA MAGI (Line 8) is less than $32K for MFJ and $25K for anybody else, 0% of SSA benefits
        are taxed. This is our bracket zero.
        Taxable portion of SSA MAGI which is more than bracket zero but less than $32K + $12K for
        MFJ and $25K + $9K for everyone else, is 50%, not to exceed 50% of SSA Benefits total.
        Taxable portion of SSA MAGI which is more than $32K + $12K for MFJ and $25K + $9K for
        everyone else, is 85%, not to exceed 85% of SSA Benefits total.
        If TP is MFS which lived together for any part of the year, all SSA Benefits are taxed at
        85%.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>32000</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>

facts.description: 1. Consider jobs/pensions that go to December 31. If all jobs/pensions end before December 31, jump to step (2). 1. Add annualized income and calculate percentages for each continuing job. 2. Allocate 4a to the job/pension with the highest percentage. If all jobs/pensions are the same, apply to the first. 2. If all jobs/pensions end earlier, use different proportions based on income left in the year, similarly to 3/4c 1. Allocate 4a to the job/pension with highest percentage of income for the rest of the year End
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/w4Line4aWithSplitWithholdingStrategy">
  <Description>1. Consider jobs/pensions that go to December 31. If all jobs/pensions end before December 31, jump to step (2).
           1. Add annualized income and calculate percentages for each continuing job.
           2. Allocate 4a to the job/pension with the highest percentage. If all jobs/pensions are the same, apply to the first.
        2. If all jobs/pensions end earlier, use different proportions based on income left in the year, similarly to 3/4c
           1. Allocate 4a to the job/pension with highest percentage of income for the rest of the year
        End</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/net4aOr4bIsIncomeIncrease"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <All>
                  <Dependency path="/continuingSourcesExist"/>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path=".."/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Dependency path="/jobSelectedForExtraSplitWithholdingBasedOnAnnualizedIncomeShare"/>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                </All>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dependency path="/net4aOr4bNetAmount"/>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <Not>
                  <Dependency path="/continuingSourcesExist"/>
                </Not>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Switch>
                  <Case>
                    <When>
                      <Equal>
                        <Left>
                          <Dependency path=".."/>
                        </Left>
                        <Right>
                          <Dependency path="/jobSelectedForExtraSplitWithholdingBasedOnFutureIncomeShare"/>
                        </Right>
                      </Equal>
                    </When>
                    <Then>
                      <Dependency path="/net4aOr4bNetAmount"/>
                    </Then>
                  </Case>
                </Switch>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <True/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dollar>0</Dollar>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: 1. Consider jobs/pensions that go to December 31. If all jobs/pensions end before December 31, jump to step (2). 1. If all jobs/pensions end earlier – use different proportions based on income left in the year 1. Allocate 4b according to proportions for income for the rest of the year End
facts.rawXml:

           1. Add annualized income and calculate percentages for each continuing job/pension
           3. Allocate 4b proportionally to total annualized income. End

      <Case>

              <Dependency path="/w4Line4NetChange"/>

      <Case>

</Fact>

            </Divide>
          </Round>

<Fact path="/jobSelectedForExtraSplitWithholdingBasedOnFutureIncomeShare">

    <Switch>

                </IsComplete>
              </Not>
              <GreaterThanOrEqual>

                  <Dependency path="/jobWithHighestFutureIncomeShare/futureIncomeShare"/>
                </Left>
                <Right>
                  <Dependency path="/pensionWithHighestFutureIncomeShare/futureIncomeShare"/>
                </Right>

<Fact path="/pensionSelectedForExtraSplitWithholdingBasedOnFutureIncomeShare">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>

            </IsComplete>
            <Any>
              <Not>
                <IsComplete>
                  <Dependency path="/jobWithHighestFutureIncomeShare"/>
                </IsComplete>
              </Not>
              <GreaterThanOrEqual>
                <Left>
                  <Dependency path="/pensionWithHighestFutureIncomeShare/futureIncomeShare"/>
                </Left>
                <Right>
                  <Dependency path="/jobWithHighestFutureIncomeShare/futureIncomeShare"/>
                </Right>

        </Then>

              </Maximum>

            <Right>
              <Dependency path="futureIncomeShare"/>

      </Collection>

<Fact path="/pensionWithHighestFutureIncomeShare">

            <Right>

        </Filter>
      </Collection>

        <Int>0</Int>
      </Index>

<Fact path="/jobs/*/futureIncomeShare">

facts.description: The income this pension will pay after the W-4P takes effect — after the lag periods.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/pensions/*/futureTentativeIncome">
  <Description>The income this pension will pay after the W-4P takes effect &#x2014; after the lag periods.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Multiply>
      <Dependency path="../averagePayPerPayPeriodForWithholding"/>
      <Dependency path="../payPeriodsWithW4pChanges"/>
    </Multiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/jobs/*/payPeriodsWithW4Changes">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <GreaterThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="../endDate"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/yearEndDate"/>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThanOrEqual>
            <Dependency path="../hasPartialPayPeriod"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Rational>1/1</Rational>
            <Dependency path="../fullPayPeriodsWithW4Changes"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="../payPeriodsWithW4ChangesRational"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/pensions/*/payPeriodsWithW4pChanges">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <All>
            <GreaterThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="../endDate"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency path="/yearEndDate"/>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThanOrEqual>
            <Dependency path="../hasPartialPayPeriod"/>
          </All>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Rational>1/1</Rational>
            <Dependency path="../fullPayPeriodsWithW4pChanges"/>

<Fact path="/jobs/*/fullPayPeriodsWithW4Changes">

</Fact>

<Fact path="/jobs/*/payPeriodsWithW4ChangesRational">

  <Derived>

          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/treatFilersAsDependents"/>
          </Not>

          <Dependency path="/normalStandardDeduction"/>

</Fact>

facts.name: Student Loan Amount Phase Out Multiplier
facts.description: Phaseout amount for the student loan deduction. Described in instructions for 1040, schedule 1, line 21. Corresponds with Line 8 of the Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet. Returns 0 if there is no phaseout
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/studentLoanAmountPhaseOutAmount">
  <Name>Student Loan Amount Phase Out Multiplier</Name>
  <Description>Phaseout amount for the student loan deduction. Described in instructions for 1040, schedule
        1, line 21. Corresponds with Line 8 of the Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet.
        Returns 0 if there is no phaseout</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Divide>
      <Dividend>
        <Multiply>
          <Divide>
            <Dividend>
              <Multiply>
                <GreaterOf>
                  <Subtract>
                    <Minuend>
                      <Dependency path="/magiForStudentLoanInterestDeduction"/>
                    </Minuend>
                    <Subtrahends>
                      <Dependency path="/studentLoanPhaseOutStart"/>
                    </Subtrahends>
                  </Subtract>
                  <Dollar>0</Dollar>
                </GreaterOf>
                <Dollar>10</Dollar>
              </Multiply>
            </Dividend>
            <Divisors>
              <Dependency path="/studentLoanPhaseOutRange"/>
            </Divisors>
          </Divide>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/studentLoanInterestAmount"/>
            <Dependency path="/maxStudentLoanDeduction"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Multiply>
      </Dividend>
      <Divisors>
        <Dollar>10</Dollar>
      </Divisors>
    </Divide>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Rounded taxable income
facts.description: Income less than $100,000 uses the tax tables from the Instructions for Form 1040. This fact selects the "midpoint" that corresponds to each entry in the tax tables, for use in calculating tentative tax.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/roundedTaxableIncome">
  <Name>Rounded taxable income</Name>
  <Description>Income less than $100,000 uses the tax tables from the Instructions for
        Form 1040. This fact selects the "midpoint" that corresponds to each entry in the
        tax tables, for use in calculating tentative tax.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThanOrEqual>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </LessThanOrEqual>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThan>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>5</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </LessThan>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>2.5</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThan>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>15</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </LessThan>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>10</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThan>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>25</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </LessThan>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>20</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThan>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>3000</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </LessThan>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Add>
            <StepwiseMultiply>
              <Multiplicand>
                <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
              </Multiplicand>
              <Rate>
                <Rational>25/25</Rational>
              </Rate>
            </StepwiseMultiply>
            <Dollar>12.5</Dollar>
          </Add>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThan>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>100000</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </LessThan>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Add>
            <StepwiseMultiply>
              <Multiplicand>
                <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
              </Multiplicand>
              <Rate>
                <Rational>50/50</Rational>
              </Rate>
            </StepwiseMultiply>
            <Dollar>25</Dollar>
          </Add>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <GreaterThanOrEqual>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dollar>100000</Dollar>
            </Right>
          </GreaterThanOrEqual>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/taxableIncome"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/maxIncomeSubjectToSocialSecurityTax">
  <Description>Schedule SE Line 7. Maximum amount of combined wages and self-employment earnings subject to social security tax or
        the 6.2% portion of the 7.65% railroad retirement (tier 1) tax for 2026. See https://www.ssa.gov/oact/cola/cbb.html</Description>
  <TaxYear>2026</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>184500</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/socialSecurityEmployeeTaxRate">
  <TaxYear>2026</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Rational>62/1000</Rational>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/medicareEmployeeTaxRate">
  <TaxYear>2026</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Rational>145/10000</Rational>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/socialSecurityTaxesWithheld">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Add>
              <LesserOf>
                <Dependency path="/earnedIncomeSelf"/>
                <Dependency path="/maxIncomeSubjectToSocialSecurityTax"/>
              </LesserOf>
              <LesserOf>
                <Dependency path="/earnedIncomeSpouse"/>
                <Dependency path="/maxIncomeSubjectToSocialSecurityTax"/>
              </LesserOf>
            </Add>
            <Dependency path="/socialSecurityEmployeeTaxRate"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <LesserOf>
              <Dependency path="/earnedIncomeSelf"/>
              <Dependency path="/maxIncomeSubjectToSocialSecurityTax"/>
            </LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/socialSecurityEmployeeTaxRate"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/medicareTaxesWithheld">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/isFilingStatusMFJ"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Add>
              <Dependency path="/earnedIncomeSelf"/>
              <Dependency path="/earnedIncomeSpouse"/>
            </Add>
            <Dependency path="/medicareEmployeeTaxRate"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Dependency path="/earnedIncomeSelf"/>
            <Dependency path="/medicareEmployeeTaxRate"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/withheldFICA">
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/socialSecurityTaxesWithheld"/>
      <Dependency path="/medicareTaxesWithheld"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Bonus withholdings are 22% if less than 1,000,000 and 37% on the sum exceeding 1,000,000. Ref: Pub 15, Section 7.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/jobs/*/withholdingsFromTotalBonusReceived">
  <Description>Bonus withholdings are 22% if less than 1,000,000 and 37% on the sum exceeding
        1,000,000. Ref: Pub 15, Section 7.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="../totalFutureBonus"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency path="/totalBonusReceivedThreshold"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodBonusAmount"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Multiply>
              <Dependency path="/bonusWithholdingPrimaryRate"/>
              <Dependency path="../totalFutureBonus"/>
            </Multiply>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency path="/bonusWithholdingPrimaryRate"/>
                <GreaterOf>
                  <Dollar>0</Dollar>
                  <Subtract>
                    <Minuend>
                      <Dependency path="/totalBonusReceivedThreshold"/>
                    </Minuend>
                    <Subtrahends>
                      <Dependency path="../mostRecentPayPeriodBonusAmount"/>
                    </Subtrahends>
                  </Subtract>
                </GreaterOf>
              </Multiply>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency path="/bonusWithholdingExcessRate"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency path="../totalBonusReceived"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency path="/totalBonusReceivedThreshold"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/jobs/*/restOfYearStandardWithholding">
  <Derived>
    <Multiply>
      <Divide>
        <Dividend>
          <Dependency path="../standardAnnualWithholdingAmount"/>
        </Dividend>
        <Divisors>
          <Dependency path="../payPeriodsPerYear"/>
        </Divisors>
      </Divide>
      <Dependency path="../fullPayPeriods"/>
    </Multiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/jobs/*/creditsNeededToFullyBridgeTaxGap">

            </Divisors>

        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>

        </Then>

    </Switch>
  </Derived>

facts.description: Result from Pub 15-T Worksheet 1A

facts.description: Date when we expect the W4 chagnes to take effect. 14 days after the current date
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/projectedW4EffectDate">
  <Description>Date when we expect the W4 chagnes to take effect. 14 days after the current date</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/today"/>
      <Days>14</Days>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/jobs/*/payPeriodsBeforeW4ChangesAppear">
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isInFuture"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>0</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyWeekly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>2</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyBiWeekly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Int>1</Int>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencySemiMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <GreaterThanOrEqual>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/projectedW4EffectDate"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <AddPayrollMonths>
                      <Dependency path="../effectiveMostRecentPayDate"/>
                      <Int>1</Int>
                    </AddPayrollMonths>
                  </Right>
                </GreaterThanOrEqual>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Int>2</Int>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <GreaterThanOrEqual>
                  <Left>
                    <Dependency path="/projectedW4EffectDate"/>
                  </Left>
                  <Right>
                    <Dependency path="../nextPayDay"/>
                  </Right>
                </GreaterThanOrEqual>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Int>1</Int>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <True/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Int>0</Int>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../isPayFrequencyMonthly"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Count>
            <GreaterThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/projectedW4EffectDate"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <AddPayrollMonths>
                  <Dependency path="../effectiveMostRecentPayDate"/>
                  <Int>1</Int>
                </AddPayrollMonths>
              </Right>
            </GreaterThanOrEqual>
          </Count>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/withholdingAmountPerPayPeriodTotalForJobsAndPensions">
  <Description>The total amount to withhold from the employee's wages this pay period for all jobs and pensions.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <CollectionSum>
        <Dependency path="/jobsAvailableForExtraWithholding/*/withholdingAmountPerPayPeriod"/>
      </CollectionSum>
      <CollectionSum>
        <Dependency path="/pensionsAvailableForExtraWithholding/*/withholdingAmountPerPayPeriod"/>
      </CollectionSum>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Whether the taxpayer needs to make estimated payments to make up the balance. In short, if the amount that needs to be withheld per pay period is greater than (or equal to, being conservative with the calculation is helpful to the taxpayer here) than the amount of money available.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/mayNeedToMakeEstimatedPayments">
  <Description>Whether the taxpayer needs to make estimated payments to make up the balance.

        In short, if the amount that needs to be withheld per pay period is greater than (or equal to, being conservative
        with the calculation is helpful to the taxpayer here) than the amount of money available.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/withholdingAmountPerPayPeriodTotalForJobsAndPensions"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
      <GreaterThanOrEqual>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/withholdingAmountPerPayPeriodTotalForJobsAndPensions"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Add>
            <CollectionSum>
              <Dependency path="/jobsAvailableForExtraWithholding/*/averageTaxablePayPerPayPeriod"/>
            </CollectionSum>
            <CollectionSum>
              <Dependency path="/pensionsAvailableForExtraWithholding/*/averagePayPerPayPeriodForWithholding"/>
            </CollectionSum>
          </Add>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThanOrEqual>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.description: Returns true if the user has pay periods remaining to reflect changes made with the W-4.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/eligibleRemainingPayPeriodsGreaterThanZero">
  <Description>Returns true if the user has pay periods remaining to reflect
        changes made with the W-4.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Any>
      <Dependency path="/hasJobsAvailableForExtraWithholding"/>
      <Dependency path="/hasPensionsAvailableForExtraWithholding"/>
    </Any>
  </Derived>
</Fact>
